buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Qualifying Criteria a. The bidder should be manufacturer of equipment/system of required capacity/ configuration OR Authorized dealer/channel partner/distributor of a manufacturer of the equipment/system to quote on behalf of their manufacturer in case manufacturer does not quote directly. In such a case, the a uthorized dealer/channel partner/distributor shall have to submit a general dealership or authorize d certificate issued by manufacturer without reference to any specific tender and having validity of such authorization for considerable duration shall be eligible for the particular tender. b. A valid ISO certification of manufacture for manufacturing the specified equipments /system shoul d be submitted with the bid. c. In case a dealer/channel partner/distributor is participating in a tender on behalf of one manufact urer, he is not allowed to participate/quote on behalf of another manufacturer in this tender or in a parallel for the same item. All such bids with same make/manufacturer will be rejected. d. The Bidder should have supplied at least two similar equipment/ systems of same capacity or high er in previous ten years. Definition of Similar equipment/system:-“Supply, Installation, Testing and Commission ing (SITC) of Auto/Manual Synchronization Panel/Module/Relay” in any Generating Pow er Plant/Power Station or any Switchyard/Sub-Station of above 66 KV rating. e. The equipment/system supplied should have performed satisfactorily for one year from the date o f commissioning. The bidder should furnish the performance report from the clients. f. The reference date for considering the period of eligibility/qualifying requirements above shall be last day of the month previous to the one in which tenders are invited. g. Bids of those Bidders who have not submitted the Earnest Money Deposit shall not be considered for evaluation. However for all the category of bidders (in addition to MSEs and Startups) as menti oned in GeM GTC (Latest version) are exempted from submission of Bid Security /EMD. h. MSEs who are holding valid Udyam Registration and are manufacturer of the offered Product (Pri mary Product), must give specific confirmation to this effect at the time of bid submission. i. Bidders other than as mentioned above, should submit Account Payee Demand Draft (DD)/Ba nker Cheque (BC) only of requisite amount in favour of: NHPC Limited, Payable at Bank: State Bank of India, Branch: Khairi, IFSC Code: SBIN0008844 at following address within 5 working days of bid opening, failing which the bid may be treated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bi d by buyer without making any reference to the seller. Group Senior Manager (P&C); Sewa-II Power Station, NHPC Ltd., Mashka, Post office: Khairi Distt.:-Chamba-176325(H.P.) j. Bidder should submit the acceptance of Detailed Technical Specifications along with their technic al bid. k. Bidder should submit the filled Technical Compliance Sheet along with their technical bid. l. Bidder should submit the acceptance of complete Integrity Pact along with their technical bid. m. Bidder should submit the acceptance of Scope of Work & Special Conditions of Contract along with their technical bid. n. The supplier should give the system support and guarantee from OEM for availability of spares for at least next ten years without fail from commissioning. . 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Generic

Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
